title: Pierce-bomb power-up — blast walks through the first soft block
notes: Promotes GDP-2026-05-26-002 (priority: should, KABOOM-CREW-MVP-2). The first far-future power-up from gameplay-systems.md §5.3: a Pierce bomb's blast walks through the first soft block in each direction without stopping (still destroying it). Subsequent soft blocks in the same direction stop the blast as normal — pierce is single-block, not infinite. Tactical depth = stack pierce + range = long block-clearing lines threading enemies behind cover.

Schema: BomberStats.pierce + Bomb.pierce as optional booleans (default false). Pickup.kind gains 'pierce'. The pierce flag is CARRIED AT PLACEMENT — bomb-placement copies BomberStats.pierce → Bomb.pierce when spawning, so the owner can lose pierce after the bomb is on the ground without the bomb losing it.

Single source of truth for the pierce rule lives in the project's blast-propagation-system. The server-side blast-propagation in node-world-server gets the same branch in a follow-up story (deferred to a connected-mode sprint when one is open).

stories.title: bomb-placement-system: copy BomberStats.pierce → Bomb.pierce at spawn
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/bomb-placement-system.ts — when building the Bomb component on the placed bomb entity, read BomberStats.pierce on the owner and stamp it into the Bomb component. stories.title: blast-propagation: walk through the FIRST soft block when bomb.pierce is true
stories.summary: examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/blast-propagation-system.ts — the propagation loop is the key change. Pre-fix: walk cells in each direction; stop at first hard block, destroy + stop at first soft block. Pierce: walk cells in each direction; stop at first hard block; destroy + CONTINUE on the first soft block; destroy + stop on the second soft block. Each direction tracks its own pierce-budget (1) independently. The pierce flag is read off the Bomb component (not the owner's BomberStats — see SCHEMA + PLACEMENT stories).
verification: acceptance: blast-propagation per-direction pierceBudget = (event.pierce ? 1 : 0). On first soft-block hit: destroy + decrement budget + continue when budget > 0; otherwise stop. Hard blocks ALWAYS stop. bomb-fuse copies bomb.pierce → BlastEvent.pierce. BlastEvent schema extended with optional pierce field.

stories.title: Unit tests covering pierce pickup → flag → bomb → blast
stories.summary: Cover the chain: (1) pickup-collect-system test — pierce pickup flips BomberStats.pierce; (2) bomb-placement-system test — pierce owner places → Bomb.pierce true; non-pierce → Bomb.pierce false/undefined; (3) blast-propagation tests: pierce + 2 soft blocks in a row → both destroyed; pierce + 3 soft blocks → first + second destroyed, third untouched; non-pierce baseline test stays green; pierce + hard block → still stops at hard block; multi-direction independence (4 directions × 2 destroyed each); range interaction (range=2 + pierce extends the lane by 1 extra-past-soft-block).
verification: acceptance: 6 new tests in bomb-blast-system.test.ts (pierce 2-block / 3-block / hard-wall stop / multi-direction / non-pierce baseline / event-carries-pierce) + 2 in pickup-collect + 2 in bomb-placement. Existing tests untouched. 322/322 kaboom tests pass.
